126202.overview:
One of the few Game & Watch units to feature full color, Donkey Kong Circus is a remake of the second Mickey Mouse Game & Watch game, which was released worldwide seven months earlier

Donkey Kong balances on a barrel while juggling pineapples and avoiding the flaming torches. Mario watches his performance. If Donkey Kong loses a pineapple, Mario would laugh at him. If Donkey Kong manages to grasp a fireball, he will flail.

126204.overview: Donkey Kong II is a Game & Watch game released as a part of the Multi Screen series on March 7, 1983. It is a dual-screen single-player Game & Watch with a brown body. It opens like a compact, with an upper and lower screen. Hirokazu Tanaka composed the game music.

126205.overview: Donkey Kong Jr. is a Game & Watch edition of the original arcade game. As in the arcade game, Donkey Kong is captured by Mario, and Donkey Kong Jr. must save him.

126207.overview: Donkey Kong is a Game & Watch game released as a part of the Multi Screen series on June 3, 1982. It is a dual-screen single-player Game & Watch with an orange body. It opens like a compact, with an upper and lower screen. This game was also the first Game & Watch to feature a directional pad.

126232.overview: A Schiacciapensieri Polistil release for Italy. Survival-tool type with a built-in flashlight and compass.

135220.overview: The Coleco Donkey Kong Jr. tabletop handheld (Model 2398) was released in 1983 and is a officially licensed, rebranded version of Nintendo's own Game & Watch Tabletop system. While Coleco originally planned to release it in their famous signature mini-arcade cabinet style, they pivoted before production to use Nintendo's exact internal hardware wrapped in an orange Coleco-branded shell.

135255.overview: The Table Top version of Donkey Kong Jr. has a bigger screen, enhanced color graphics and sound effects due to the color LCD (CLCD) model and larger housing, compared to its Wide Screen counterpart. Despite the similar name, the organization of the traps, level design and presence of helium balloons (which weren't part of the original version), alters the gameplay.

135735.overview: Donkey Kong is a VFD game based on the arcade original. It was developed and released by Coleco in 1982 as part of the company's tabletop arcade game series.

142003.overview: Donkey Kong Jr. is a New Wide Screen, Tabletop, and Panorama Game & Watch game initially released in 1982. The Tabletop and Panorama versions are pretty much the same game, though the New Wide Screen version is different. The model numbers for the game are DJ-101, CJ-71, and CJ-93 for the New Wide Screen, Tabletop, and Panorama version, respectively. DJ stands for Donkey Kong Jr. while CJ stands for Color Jr. Nintendo manufactured 1,000,000 copies of the New Wide Screen version worldwide, though they only made 250,000 copies each of the other two.

147974.overview: A fun little adventure in the dungeon! Find the magic arrow, avoid the traps and get that dragon!

149339.overview: This game was released outside Japan as Fishing Boy.

154212.overview: Tabletop game in which player races acar along the 'real' moving plastic track. This early electronic game features a lap counter, 4 speed settings and steering wheel.

169589.overview: Donkey Kong Hockey is one of the few two-player Game & Watch games ever manufactured. It was released as a part of the Micro Vs. series on November 13, 1984. Donkey Kong and Mario must engage each other in a two-player game of ice hockey. The game is colorless, being set up on a small LCD screen. The console is an elliptical shape, while the controllers are small and circular; the console can open up to store the controllers.

173941.overview: Donkey Kong and Stanley are trying to prevent the bees from reaching their own garden, forcing the bees to their rival's side using bug spray. The player move up and down, refilling the spray gun and shooting clouds of spray to push the bees to the opponent's side.

190398.overview: Dennis the Menace is a handheld LCD electronic video game developed by Tiger Electronics.

190399.overview: Double Dragon is a handheld LCD electronic video game developed by Tiger Electronics, based on Taito's Double Dragon arcade game.

190400.overview: Double Dragon 3: The Rosetta Stone is a handheld LCD electronic video game developed by Tiger Electronics, based on Technos Double Dragon 3 arcade game.

190440.overview: Dokodemo Dorayaki Doraemon is a maze-chase game that released in Japan in 1983 on FL LSI Tabletop. This game was heavily influenced by PAC-MAN games, but with Doraemon characters.

190442.overview:
The only FL Flat Type game. With very compact handheld design, and a colourful VFD display. It's one of the last VFD games ever made.

There are 2 scenes:
First the drive to the enemy base, and later the shootout inside the enemy base.

190478.overview: You are a treasure hunter seeking the treasure hidden in a coffin in Dracula's castle. But watch out — dangers lie ahead! You must escape the Wolfman, break down a wall to enter the Underground Labyrinth and evade a Vampire Bat as you try to collect all the diamonds. In Dracula's Castle, there are four coffins. Chose carefully — only one coffin contains the treasure. If you open the wrong one, you'll find Dracula inside instead of the treasure.

190480.overview: LSI game based on the famous arcade game.

419638.overview: A full featured LED football game. Huge screen, nice controls, instant replay, many plays to choose from, and even a half time show.  Has a patented 'playmaker' control scheme where you can choose your play without your opponent seeing what direction you pressed. A very strange patent - Tiger must have assumed all the other handheld game companies would steal this idea, when in actuality the handheld LED sports market collapsed right around this time.

455679.overview:
THE THRILLS AND EXCITEMENT OF THE TOP ARCADE GAME IN THE PALM OF YOUR HAND!

Only you are left. Left to take on the entire army of BLACK SHADOW WARRIORS. Left to push them out of the city. To follow them back to the dangerous source of their operation. Back to where their Leader is. Back to where you can avenge the loss of "MARION". You have to use every DOUBLE DRAGON martial arts move you have mastered including your swing kick. And that is where this adventure begins . . . and continues through 9 missions.

Features including Sound On/Off, Highest Score Retained, Automatic Shut Off and More!

There are many powerful enemies and dangerous traps in the missions.

Try a 'Swing Kick' to beat the enemies coming at you from both sides.

Beware of the secret and deadly traps at the end of the mission

In the final mission, you are facing the Shadow Boss. He will act as a shadow following you. Try to escape him to avoid losing.

476150.overview: Just imagine going back in time! Gamers who are die-hard fans into retro tech, or are new to this genre, will love this Tiger Electronics: Disney The Little Mermaid electronic LCD video game, inspired by the original from the 1990s. It's a journey of discovery as players help Ariel pick up human possessions. But beware of Ursula, the evil sea witch! The design and technology were created with the original handheld game unit in mind. Look for other retro-inspired Tiger Electronics LCD video games. (Each sold separately. Subject to availability.)

476446.overview:
Can Belle turn the Beast back into a prince before the last rose petal falls? The answer is in your hands! Help Belle move through the Beast's castle! With your help, Belle can find her father, Maurice! With your help, she can become friends with the Enchanted Objects! With your help, Belle can save the Beast from Gaston and LeFou! With your help, true love can win! See this great Disney adventure come alive in your hands!

You must find Maurice! Dodge behind the wall so the Beast doesn't see you! Later on, Belle and the Beast will become friends!

Give roses to the Enchanted Objects! You'll make them very happy! But don't let the Beast see you!

Get past Gaston and kiss the Beast! If Belle can kiss the Beast 4 times before the last rose petal falls from the timer, he'll turn back into a Prince!

476604.overview:
Experience the fun of this classic Disney movie - right in your own hands! The evil Cruella De Vil has dognapped Pongo and Perdita's puppies and taken them to Hell Hall! With your help, Perdita and Pongo can rescue their puppies plus all the others - 99 together - and bring them safely back to London! Jump over obstacles, crawl through walls, run like the win, and save those puppies! You'll have to outsmart Cruella and her henchmen, Horace and Jasper Badun! But you can do it!

Congratulations, the puppies are on board! Now the van is pulling into the road! It's going to crash into the car of the evil Cruella De Vil!

There's the van to carry the pups to safety! Press the JUMP button and Pongo and Perdita can jump in! Then press the TAKE key - and Pongo can take the puppies aboard one by one!

It's a happy ending! Pongo and Perdita are reunited with their puppies and all the other puppies they've rescued as well! Just think - 99 puppies and Pongo and Perdita. It's 101 Dalmatians!

477041.overview:
Simba, the lion cub is next in line to become lion king! But before he becomes king, Simba faces many dangerous obstacles and enemies that stand in his way. It is not until he completes the circle of life that he can accept the responsibility and claim his destiny as lion king! Guide Simba through jungle dangers, wild stampedes, ravenous hyenas and evil Scar, who wants to be king! There are also friends along the way like Pumbaa and Timon! Complete all four stages and defeat evil Scar to claim the title of lion king!

Young Simba is lured into the elephant graveyard! Guide him past sharp elephant bones, pools of water and hot steam shooting up from the ground!

Simba's two friends, Pumbaa and Timon, love to eat bugs! Help them catch bugs so Simba won't eat them!

Grown Simba must complete the final part of the circle of life to become "lion king". Help him defeat the evil Scar before it's too late!

477137.overview:
Can you help Aladdin survive the streets of Agrabah and rescue Abu from the palace guards? You have the answer in your hands! Take Aladdin through the Cave of Wonders to find the magic lamp and dodge attacks from the Monkey Idol before it's too late! With your help, Aladdin can battle the evil Jafar and free Jasmine from the hourglass! And remember, you are granted three wishes from the Genie to save you from danger—use them wisely!

Aladdin is a poor street boy who goes to the marketplace in search of food, but the palace guards want to stop him and Abu! Throw apples at the guards to rescue Abu!

Aladdin is in the Cave of Wonders, but the Monkey Idol is guarding the cave and wants to stop him. Try to dodge his attacks, or call the Genie to use on of your wishes to rescue Aladdin!

Jafar has turned into a giant snake! You must hit him with a sword to score points and defeat him!

477258.overview:
Welcome to the way cool world of Goof Troop! Max and PJ are on their skateboards trying to pick up aluminum cans to recycle and to earn some cash to buy some tickets to a really cool concert! Along the way they run into some wild obstacles, like Goofy on a skateboard and PJ's dad Pete dropping cans right in their path! The neatest part of the ride is "The Loop"! Steer Max around the obstacles and through "The Loop" ramp to score as many points as you can! Score enough points and see Maxola get a high-five from the Peejster!

Steer Max around obstacles as he picks up cans to recycle and to earn cash for concert tickets!

Watch out for Goofy and PJ on skateboards or you'll crash!

Steer Max and his skateboard onto the "Loop" ramp for a wild ride that will score you bonus points!

477408.overview: Take Aladdin through the Cave of Wonders to find the magic lamp and dodge attacks from the Monkey Idol before it's too late! With your help, Aladdin can battle the evil Jafar and free Jasmine from the hourglass! And remember, you are granted three wishes from the Genie to save you from danger use them wisely.

478154.overview: Guide Hercules through training, fight monsters like the Hydra, fly on Pegasus to defeat Titans, and save Meg in the Underworld.

478237.overview:
The greatest detective of them all, Darkwing Duck, needs your help to put Quackerjack, Megavolt, and Bushroot where they belong — in jail! See if you can shoot straight using the gas gun, the famous gun that shoots laughing gas! Your pal, Launchpad, will supply you with bombs so you can get a real "bang" out of life! But be sure to pick up the bombs before the bad guys do!

Shoot laughing gas with the gas gun, your favorite weapon!

Your best friend, Launchpad, will supply you with bombs!

Pick up the bombs before the bad guys do!

481617.overview:
Race with Cole Trickle through 99 levels of increasing challenge. Realistic sounds of engines, brakes and crashes pull you into the action. Guide your stock car through speeding traffic as you monitor speed and fuel, trying to cross the finish line before time expires. Keep an eye on your fuel gauge to know when to make a pit stop. You are the best of the stock car competition if you can finish level 10.

Features include 99 Levels of Play, Sound On/Off, Highest Score Retained, Automatic Shut Off and More!

Watch the start light but don't jump the gun. Race through 99 levels.

Monitor the fuel gauge and check the tires. Use the pit stop for needed repairs.

Realistic engine sounds show you have crashed. Begin again -- but be careful!

Pass as many cars as you can within the specified time limit.

482396.overview: Guide a diver through the underwater hazards of Tronica's handheld LCD game. Movement follows fixed positions on the display, so progress depends on choosing the right moment to leave safety. Collect points while avoiding dangerous encounters and the mistakes that bring an attempt to an end. Its simple controls put the emphasis on timing.
